market_view: Thursday's AI-led rout (S&P 500 -4.4%, QQQ -6.5%, VIX 27) is bouncing in pre-market, with chip names reported up 4-8% and Nasdaq futures up about 1.4-1.8%. The October jobs report at 8:30 ET (soft hiring, 4.2% unemployment expected) can flip the tape either way, so size is trimmed and every order carries a stop. Gold and crude held up during the selloff.
shared_notes: Council: staging entries over weeks is sensible after a 5-day, 19% chip slide; NVDA earnings Nov 17 is the big event.
Sam and Fox both wait for the 8:30 jobs print before committing; Vega only plays the chip bounce if it holds after the open.
Fox's gold and Kai's crypto are sandbox ideas: not possible in your TFSA.

options_aggr.view: Chip bounce is tempting but the tape is violent; one short-dated call on NVDA, risk capped by the premium.

orders.why: Buy a short-dated NVDA call (a bet it rises) after the rebound in chip stocks; the most I can lose is the premium, and NVDA reports Nov 17, so I plan to exit before then.

options_safe.view: VIX at 27 makes premiums rich, but I stay far out of the money and keep half in cash in a risk-off tape; no new puts before the jobs print.
